cause: The initial teacher launcher inherited the historical ENV dictionary source label. That environment variable is not evidence of the actual executed file contents.
reproduction_rule: Use the archived runtime plus each episode source_overlay.tar.gz, execution.json source_sha256, RESEARCH_ROLE.json wrapper hash and original model/config hashes. Do not reconstruct this run by checking out the stale environment label alone.
validation: All four teacher queues underwent independent source-content, actor/filter, actuator and physical-substep audit. Their immutable audit copies are TEACHER_QUEUE_0_AUDIT.json through TEACHER_QUEUE_3_AUDIT.json.
later_launchers: Controller development and later launchers explicitly override SII_SOURCE_BASE_COMMIT; run-specific source hashes remain authoritative even when a base commit label is correct.
